issues.text: Carried from prior review (text unchanged by this edit). The added sentence says the Tempo lever 'saves disk, not nodes' in the repository, and the next sentence restates the file as 'the levers lower the node count' with no exception. Both are faithful to their sources (compose runs Tempo outside any cluster; cluster-cost.md line 112 'Các đòn bẩy giảm số node'), but read together they contradict each other on the fourth lever.
issues.quote: The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count, and that none reduces the fixed platform share
issues.fix: Write: "The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count (in the repository, all but the telemetry lever), and that none reduces the fixed platform share, except removing a cluster or an environment."

issues.quote: Các manifest của những thành phần này cũng chưa đặt request, trừ Prometheus (100m / 128Mi).
issues.text: New, in changed block. The excerpt now says one platform component, Prometheus, does set requests (100m / 128Mi). The English prose never says this: the sentence before the block gives the platform total as '950m and 1984Mi (assumed)', and the paragraph after it ('The first paragraph adds workloads and platform') skips the exception. Nothing contradicts it (the prose only says that among workloads only api sets requests), but I paused: is Prometheus's 100m / 128Mi a set value inside an assumed total?
issues.fix: In 'The first paragraph adds workloads and platform, ...', add one clause first: 'Among the platform, only Prometheus's manifest sets requests (100m / 128Mi); the rest of the 950m and 1984Mi is assumed.'

issues.quote: so in the repository this lever saves disk, not nodes. Choosing those numbers is left to `cost-per-shop.md`. The last sentence says that the levers lower the node count
issues.text: Carried from prior review (text unchanged by this edit). Two sentences after I am told the telemetry lever saves disk, not nodes, I read that 'the levers lower the node count' with no exception. I stop and wonder whether the fourth lever counts or not. I can work out that the file speaks in general and the repo is a special case, but nothing says so.
issues.fix: In the last sentence, add '(in the repository, all but the telemetry lever)' after 'the levers lower the node count'.

issues.quote: Tempo is in neither sum above: it runs in the lab, not in a cluster
issues.text: Carried from prior review (text unchanged by this edit). 'The lab' is never said in English prose; in the excerpt 'Lab không cài metrics-server' seems to mean the kind clusters themselves. So 'in the lab, not in a cluster' made me re-read: where does Tempo run, if the lab is the clusters? I only get 'outside any cluster' from the second half.
issues.fix: Replace 'it runs in the lab, not in a cluster' with 'it runs as a Compose service on your machine, not in any cluster'.
